activities.activity: Sleeping in her own room with the door closed and quiet hours respected for rest and recovery
Waking slowly, sitting up in bed and saying her morning prayers before starting the day
Washing her face, brushing her teeth and getting dressed for her early cafe opening shift
Making and eating a quick breakfast she prepares herself, with a strong cup of tea from her labelled tea shelf
Driving her small car to the cafe for the early opening shift
Working her barista shift: opening the cafe, pulling espresso, serving customers and packing up leftover food to take home
Driving to the Monash University campus and eating a quick self-prepared lunch before class
Attending design studio class at Monash University, working on critique and project development
Taking public transport home after class, carrying the cafe leftovers she plans to share
Cooking her own dinner in a cleared, clearly labelled section of the kitchen while sipping tea
Eating dinner and putting the shared cafe leftovers in the labelled fridge container
Washing up her pans, wiping her bench space and loading the dishwasher
Working on her design deadline at her desk with the desk lamp on, sketching ideas and refining files on her computer
Taking a warm shower and winding down after a long day of work and study
Making a last caffeine-free herbal tea before quiet hours begin
Saying her evening prayers and reading quietly under the lamp with the space heater on low
Going to sleep in her own room with the light off and quiet hours kept around her room
